best_echo_sets.commentary: Best set for Lily for general use. Since she buffs both Echo and Unison characters and Flower of Tinged Yearning only provides full buffs to Unison characters, this is her best set to take advantage of her two-sided buffing profile.

main_echo_options.echo_commentary: Allows Rejuvenating Glow to provide as many total buffs as Flower of Tinged Yearning on cast, giving an extra 10% ATK to the team and an extra 10% Energy Regen to the wearer. It can easily be summoned before Lily's Ultimate to have roughly the same effects as her Signature set, with the added perk of working in more than just Unison teams.

best_echo_sets.commentary: Comfort set option for now, as Lily can be used in both Unison and Echo teams. Has 10s more uptime on 10% ATK to the team and Energy Regen to Lily herself. The drawback is that these buffs only apply to Unison teams, so if you want to take advantage of Lily's Echo Skill buffing capabilities, this set is inferior.

main_echo_options.echo_commentary: Provides 10% Energy Regen when equipped in the main slot. Simple Summon Echo that ensures Energy Regen requirements are met a bit easier.

best_weapons.commentary_details: Lily's Signature is 1 of 2 weapons that allow her to maximize her Energy Regen requirements. Best weapon by a slight margin, giving her the Concerto she needs to speed up her Opener on top of two buffs: 24% party-wide Echo Skill DMG Bonus for all characters, and 16% ATK to Unison characters only.

cons: Has like, one slightly decent Quickswap window after her Opener rotation, and only buffs active on-field characters which really mitigates Quickswap use on top of making her incompatible with Phrolova;
On every Echo team, is just an alternative to Shorekeeper, never a stronger option. This is especially true in Quickswap as we explained earlier;
Until S2, lacks CRIT consistency in Unison teams. This lowers her value in Whimpering Wastes if Shorekeeper is on your account since she covers this exact problem by default;

Who allowed her to wield a gun? We're pretty sure she's illegally carrying that thing.
pros: Top-tier support for top-tier teams in all endgames. Easy to understand where her value is;
Has access to constant off-field grouping at regular intervals and on every Intro (though not as good as Denia's grouping, it's still pretty good);

Much like many other Supports of her kind, doesn't mind skipping her Signature weapon, and doesn't mind lower Echo investments (just needs Energy Regen requirements, and after that investing into damage is an optional bonus);

sections.heading: Summary
paragraphs: Lily is a 5-star Spectro Pistol Support who specializes in supporting Unison and Echo Skill characters. She's essentially a repeat of Shorekeeper for those two team archetypes, making her a fundamentally easy character to pick up, build, and play.

sections.heading: Key Mechanics
paragraphs: Lily doesn't have a single focal point in her kit. Generally, the most important things are her Skill, Intro, Forte gauge and Ultimate.

Lily has 2 different states that she switches between via her Skill that allow her to cast different Heavy Attacks: Fairytale and Phantasm. By default, she starts in Fairytale state. Generally speaking, both Heavy Attacks accomplish the same goal of restoring a lot of Concerto once the Forte gauge is filled up, on top of providing an ATK buff based on Unison Boon stacks, as well as an Echo CRIT Rate and CRIT DMG buff. They are in two steps each: a mid-air phase and a plunge for Fairytale state, and a charge into a projectile shot for Phantasm, roughly taking the same amount of field time.

To get there though, Lily has to restore her Forte gauge first. This is where all other elements of her kit start to intertwine. Her Forte gauge can be replenished through her Basic Attacks, her Skill, or her Enhanced Intro. It gets expended once to start casting her Forte Heavies, then she has to replenish it once again during her Forte Heavy animation to finish her rotation off.

Technically, her Skill has two variants that allow her to switch states, but they accomplish the exact same thing in terms of damage and Forte regeneration. Where it starts differing is her Intro. If Lily has cast her Ultimate, is still in her Ultimate state, and Intros back into the field, she interrupts her Ultimate state and, in exchange, gains access to a powerful Enhanced Intro that restores a bunch of Concerto, Forte, speeds up her Forte Heavies by adding some initial Forte charge, and allows her to start her Basic string from Basic 3.

Speaking of her Ultimate, it causes Lily to literally fall asleep on the battlefield. Setting the real-world counter-productive nature of this aside, Lily becomes incapable of any action during her Ultimate. It lasts for 50s, unless manually interrupted via either pressing Ultimate again or casting her Enhanced Intro. Aside from that, it gives her a big Concerto boost and triggers some additional ATK% buffs, so Lily always wants to finish her rotation with it. Her Ultimate also has the additional effect of grouping enemies every time an Intro is cast, and every 5s via a directional input.
In short: Lily wants to build up her Forte gauge through a mix of Basic Attacks and Skills before casting her Forte Heavies into her Ultimate to finish off her rotation.

sections.heading: Who Does She Buff & How?
paragraphs: Let's provide a recap of how exactly Lily buffs characters on your team:
Through her Forte Heavies: Casting Outro within 6s of them gives the following buffs to the active character for 30s:
For Unison Response characters only: 7% ATK per stack of Unison Boon, up to 4;
10% Echo Skill CRIT Rate and 20% Echo Skill CRIT DMG;
Through her Ultimate: For 25s, each Intro other than Lily's provides 7% ATK to the active character, up to 28% at 4 Intros;
Through her Outro: 25% team-wide DMG Amplification for 30s;
Through her Echo set: 25% team-wide ATK (for 20s on Rejuvenating Glow, 30s on Flower of Tinged Yearning for Unison characters only);
Through her Signature weapon: 16% ATK to Unison characters, and 24% Echo Skill DMG to the active character;
She also has a bunch of healing and other safeguards on her passives, Ultimate, and Forte Heavies.

That's a total of 97% ATK to Unison characters (39% in other teams), 25% DMG Amplification, plus 10% Echo Skill CRIT Rate, 20% Echo Skill CRIT DMG, and 24% Echo Skill DMG, including her Signature. A very ATK-focused buffing profile for Unison, while Echo Skill characters get a wider array of more standard buffs. Non-Unison and Echo characters only get 39% ATK and 25% DMG Amplification alongside Echo Skill buffs that don't really make a difference, so generally, she won't be much better than Verina (if at all) in those instances.

Note: The 97% ATK Lily can provide to Unison characters is only theoretical. In the Hsin/Suoming/Lily team, the only Unison team currently available, Lily is "only" providing up to 90% ATK unless Hsin is S6.

sections.heading: Meta Position & Conclusion
paragraphs: Lily's meta position is interesting, is the best way we can put it. She's useful right now for some accounts, but it's obvious to us that this isn't her final form.

Let's get something out of the way first: her full Unison Boon ATK buff isn't yet able to be taken advantage of until S6 Hsin. This, and her Signature Echo Set is only fully compatible with Unison characters. Yet, she has 2 Vigor in Matrix, so it's likely she's intended to go on 2 separate teams using this set, otherwise there's no point in building it over Rejuvenating Glow, which is a set that fully works across all team compositions.

In short, it's very possible a future Unison team is to come, other than Hsin/Suoming. The thing is, we just don't know who that is yet. Whether they'll be strong meta-wise and whether you'll enjoy those characters enough to pull them, only time will tell.

As things stand, Lily is great for Sigrika and Hsin Unison, specifically. The issue is: for Galbrena and Phrolova, they don't just deal pure Echo DMG, they also deal a good amount of Heavy/Skill DMG respectively. Additionally, at least half of Phrolova's damage (being all her Echo damage) is off-field, while Lily only buffs active on-field characters. Suffice to say, there are more synergistic characters, and generally Shorekeeper is a better idea to use than Lily if she's available for those characters. That only really leaves Lily with Sigrika and Hsin Unison to play with at the top level, Galbrena being an alright option but nothing impressive.

The thing is, her top 2 teams are very strong across all endgames, and that gets Lily enough points to be worth considering. However, that's only if Shorekeeper is unavailable. While she's best in slot for Hsin Unison in theory, Lily doesn't give the team 100% CRIT Rate until S2, which means it'll be overall more inconsistent, which particularly matters for Whimpering Wastes. Lily's innate grouping compensates for that a bit, especially since her buffs are stronger than Shorekeeper's for the team on paper, but it doesn't cleanly resolve that issue.

In conclusion, Lily can be worth considering if you own Hsin Unison and/or Sigrika, want an upgrade from Verina, and don't have Shorekeeper to spare for that purpose. If you're the kind of person who really wants to optimize Endstate Matrix scores, Lily is a strong candidate for your account as well. However, make sure to keep in mind there's nuance to the character, and that her true best team is likely not released yet. She'll likely rerun alongside that team the same way Chisa did, so if you're unsure, you can skip her for now, provided your account's status doesn't justify pulling her.

synergies.commentary: Hsin is the only Unison Main DPS in the game currently (Suoming consumes Unison to become a DPS), so she is Lily's best synergy by far at the moment. Lily is at her best when paired with Unison characters, so if you use Hsin in Unison mode, Lily is a no-brainer for a premium support option, being a slight upgrade to Shorekeeper and a good upgrade from Verina overall.

Lily is pretty much just as good as Shorekeeper for on-field Echo Skill damage dealers. Since the majority of Lily's buffs only apply to the active on-field character, she doesn't work for Phrolova, so Sigrika and Galbrena remain. Galbrena is not that good of a pick either, since she deals partial Heavy Attack DMG and Lily focuses on Echo Skill DMG almost entirely. With that being said, Sigrika is a perfect fit for Lily's Echo Skill side of her kit. Her longer rotation with better buffs makes her about the same as Shorekeeper, while being worse than her in Quickswap due to being more restricted there.
